meta.title: 拍电影为什么光圈不能碰？
meta.title_en: Why Can't You Touch the Aperture When Shooting Film?

scenes.title_cn: 开场：曝光三要素过时了吗？上期解释了…
scenes.title_en: Opening: is the exposure triangle outdated…
scenes.context: 电影是蓄势的艺术，不是技术的艺术。
sentences: 曝光三要素过时了吗？
Is the exposure triangle outdated?
exposure triangle（曝光三要素）
电影是一门蓄势的艺术，而不是技术的艺术。
Film is an art of restraint, not an art of technique.
art of restraint（蓄势的艺术）
scenes.speak: Is the exposure triangle outdated? Film is an art of restraint, not an art of technique.

scenes.title_cn: 景深与表演区域：调节光圈往往忽略了很…
scenes.title_en: Depth of field and acting area: adjusting …
scenes.context: 光圈调节代价是景深，浅景深限制表演。
sentences: 调节光圈往往忽略了很重要的代价，那就是景深。
Adjusting aperture ignores a big cost: depth of field.
the cost is DOF（代价是景深）
光圈越大景深越浅，在剧情表达这一块景深太重要了。
Larger aperture, shallower DOF, and DOF is huge for storytelling.
DOF for story（景深叙事）
提高景深，就可以给两个人物更多的表演区域。
Deepening DOF gives both actors more room to perform.
more acting room（更多表演区）
paraphrase: the cost is DOF（代价是景深
the cost is DOF（代价是景深
scenes.speak: Adjusting aperture ignores a big cost: depth of field. Larger aperture, shallower DOF, and DOF is huge for storytelling. Deepening DOF gives both actors more room to perform.

scenes.title_cn: 手动跟焦的噩梦：而且电影拍摄从来不会…
scenes.title_en: The focus puller's nightmare: film never u…
scenes.context: 浅景深是跟焦员的噩梦。
sentences: 电影拍摄从来不会用自动对焦，跟焦都是活人手动完成。
Film never uses autofocus; focusing is done by hand.
hand focus（手动跟焦）
焦点的推拉紧密地调动观众的注意力。
Focus pulls steer the audience's attention tightly.
focus pull（焦点推拉）
电影拍摄光圈开到T2.8已经被视为是非常大的光圈。
Opening to T2.8 is already a very large aperture in film.
T2.8 is big（T2.8已很大）
自动跟焦的方案都是为了辅助跟焦员，而不是代替跟焦员的。
Autofocus schemes assist the focus puller, not replace him.
assist, not replace（辅助而非替代）
scenes.speak: Film never uses autofocus; focusing is done by hand. Focus pulls steer the audience's attention tightly. Opening to T2.8 is already a very large aperture in film. Autofocus schemes assist the focus puller, not replace him.

scenes.title_cn: 小屏幕与景深叙事：由于现代内容消费的…
scenes.title_en: Small screens and DOF storytelling: as mod…
scenes.context: 前后景都是剧情线索的位置。
sentences: 由于现代内容消费的中端转站到手机和平板上，屏幕越来越小。
As content consumption shifts to phones and tablets, screens get smaller.
smaller screens（屏幕变小）
背景虚化的呈现难度比大屏幕更高。
Bokeh is harder to appreciate than on big screens.
harder to show（更难呈现）
电影依赖景深来展示剧情线索，前景和背景其实都是展示剧情的重要位置。
Film uses DOF for story cues—foreground and background both matter.
front and back（前后景）
假如只有主体清晰，前后景就虚得一塌糊涂，那么画面的信息量就大大降低了。
Only subject sharp and the frame's information drops drastically.
information drops（信息量降低）
scenes.speak: As content consumption shifts to phones and tablets, screens get smaller. Bokeh is harder to appreciate than on big screens. Film uses DOF for story cues—foreground and background both matter. Only subject sharp and the frame's information drops drastically.

scenes.title_cn: 公民凯恩与艺术设计：导演、摄影、美术…
scenes.title_en: Citizen Kane and artistic design: the dire…
scenes.context: 光圈是艺术蓄势工具，与全片设计联动。
sentences: 经典作品《公民凯恩》利用了超景深的摄影手法，开拓出巨大的表演区域。
Citizen Kane used deep focus to open up a huge acting area.
deep focus（超景深）
光圈在电影拍摄中不只是技术工具，而是艺术蓄势工具。
In film, aperture is an artistic tool, not just technical.
artistic tool（艺术工具）
场地、道具、灯光、演员走位，都紧密地和光圈大小联动在一起。
Location, props, lighting, and blocking all interlock with the aperture.
all interlock（全部联动）
scenes.speak: Citizen Kane used deep focus to open up a huge acting area. In film, aperture is an artistic tool, not just technical. Location, props, lighting, and blocking all interlock with the aperture.

scenes.title_cn: 现场调整原则：光圈定好了，画面太暗加…
scenes.title_en: On-set adjustment: with the aperture set, …
scenes.context: 画面明暗靠灯光和ND，不碰光圈。
sentences: 光圈定好了，画面太暗加灯光，画面太亮加ND。
With the aperture set: dark means more light, bright means ND.
light or ND（加灯或ND）
根据现场条件预计做小范围的改动，切记是不能影响导演预想中的效果。
Small tweaks per the scene, never disturbing the director's vision.
small tweaks（小范围改动）
scenes.speak: With the aperture set: dark means more light, bright means ND. Small tweaks per the scene, never disturbing the director's vision.

practice: Adjusting aperture ignores its cost: depth of field.
Shallow DOF limits the actors' room to perform.
Film focuses by hand, so shallow DOF tortures the puller.
Small screens make bokeh harder to appreciate.
Aperture is designed with set, lights, and blocking.
pitfalls: Open the aperture for exposure freedom.
Film is an art of restraint, not technique.
Keep both actors on the same plane.
Deepen DOF to give both more room to perform.
Focus pulls are done by hand and steer attention.
Judge bokeh on a phone screen.
Small screens raise the difficulty of showing bokeh.
It's an artistic tool linked to the whole scene design.
shifts: 用 depth of field（景深）、bokeh（虚化）、art of restraint（蓄势的艺术）
用 focus puller（跟焦员）、hand focus（手动跟焦）、assist not replace（辅助而非替代）
用 story cues（剧情线索）、foreground and background（前后景）、T2.8 is already large（T2.8已算大）
